## Static Pages + local control center

GitHub Pages is the discoverable, read-only marketplace. When you need real **Installed / Update available / Install** actions, launch the same built marketplace locally:

```powershell
skillhub marketplace --open
```

The local server binds only to loopback and protects mutating API calls with an ephemeral same-origin token.
